question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who did you like giving advice to the most?
Do you like matchmaking other people?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aw, Sam... That's nice of you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Unfortunately, the time for apologies is `over.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Unfortunately, the time for apologies is [color=#3b78e2][i]over.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Anyway, I need a `date.` And I'm now accepting candidates for submission.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, I need a [color=#3b78e2][i]date.[/i][/color] And I'm now accepting candidates for submission.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We'll find you someone, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear! Happy hunting, girls!
All the cheerleaders leave.
Later, Howard and Colt join Sam and $ZOE at their house.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm so relieved Taylor didn't make me stay late today...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stay late?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, she's so mad at me about dating Colt, that she's getting her revenge by ordering me around!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What does she make you do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: At first, it started out small...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Can I ask you the teensiest favor, Sam? I totally forgot to feed Lyle today, and I know how much you `love` him.
nodes.text_bbcode: Can I ask you the teensiest favor, Sam? I totally forgot to feed Lyle today, and I know how much you [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] him.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't forget to take the wings off the flies. Lyle doesn't like it when they try to escape. Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But then it started getting bigger...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sam, you were `wobbling` during practice today. You almost dropped $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, you were [color=#3b78e2][i]wobbling[/i][/color] during practice today. You almost dropped $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you don't want to kill your fellow teammates, you're going to have to get stronger.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why don't you stay late and practice lifting these twenty-pound bags of flour for an hour?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And just yesterday, she made me wash the entire team's laundry!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It just keeps getting worse! I'm tired of Taylor picking on me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm really sick of hearing her make snide comments about my boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This has gone on long enough. I need to get her off my back.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just say the word, babe, and I can take care of a certain head cheerleader for you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, but no thanks. I'd rather just handle this on my own.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor's funny and fun to be around!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And did I mention that her favorite thing to do is tan in her bikini?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Wow, she sounds great.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And Taylor's nothing like Paula. She's much, much nicer.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hot like Paula, but better. I'm definitely interested.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You've convinced me. I'll give this date a shot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You will? Great!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You `are` smart. Thanks for the idea, cheerleader.
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] smart. Thanks for the idea, cheerleader.

nodes.text: Later, at home...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know if I have the patience for this, $ZOE. Everyone asking me questions and me giving answers? Red! Blue! Yes! No!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Sam, it's great that everyone is asking you for advice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, but who knew that playing Cupid would be so hard?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just be patient.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh... If it hadn't been for setting Taylor up, no one would think twice about asking me for help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How are things going with Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not as bad as they were before.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just hope her dating Bryce will make things better for me before she starts getting too creative with her punishments...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Girls do like men who persevere. And if you really like this Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You mean if `Fryan` really likes Jessica...
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean if [color=#e23b3b][i]Fryan[/i][/color] really likes Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then Jessica will have to eventually notice who he is.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: So you're saying `Fryan` should keep trying. But he's tried that before... And she always runs screaming.
nodes.text_bbcode: So you're saying [color=#e23b3b][i]Fryan[/i][/color] should keep trying. But he's tried that before... And she always runs screaming.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Third time's a charm! I've heard girls like to be chased...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: They do? This will be easy. He can run.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'll tell him to find Jessica and keep asking her to the dance until she says 'yes.'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe your problem...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Fryan's problem.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Right. Maybe `Fryan's` problem is that he has the plan all wrong. Maybe `Fryan` needs to give up on Jessica and ask someone else.
nodes.text_bbcode: Right. Maybe [color=#3b78e2][i]Fryan's[/i][/color] problem is that he has the plan all wrong. Maybe [color=#3b78e2][i]Fryan[/i][/color] needs to give up on Jessica and ask someone else.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Like who? Fryan's a ladies' man with a lot of experience... And he's kind of gone through a lot of women.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hm, let's see... Who would be willing to tolerate a guy like Ryan?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fryan should ask out Nicole!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Really? You'd think she'd really go for him?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nicole is an adventurous person who is willing to make out with almost anything.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think you... Er, Fryan and Nicole would be great together.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I didn't think of her... Wow, forget Jessica. He should ask Nicole.
Later that day...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, you're Sam, right?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Heard you're giving advice, and I have this, uh, cousin that needs some... Help.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: His name is, uh... `Fryan.` And he's kind of like me.
nodes.text_bbcode: His name is, uh... [color=#e23b3b][i]Fryan.[/i][/color] And he's kind of like me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Fryan doesn't have any trouble getting girls normally, but, uh, that Valentine's Ball is coming up.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And the girls Fryan asked out are going with their boyfriends or 'don't want anything to do with his disgusting face' or something stupid like that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let me guess, Fryan needs help finding a date? Doesn't Fryan have another friend he can ask instead?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Uhm, he asked me. But now I'm asking you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, fine. Who does he want to date?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: There's this cheerleader, Jessica, that Fryan really likes, but she kinda ran away screaming the last time he asked.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Fryan thinks if he can just remain cool and suave and keep asking her out, she'll agree...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Does that sound like a good plan for Fryan?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, if you don't want to be seen as one of the boys, you need to become a girl.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I am a girl.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, but you need them to see that. Shake them out of however they see you now. It's like shock therapy.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: So what you're saying is that I should wear a dress and make-up?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I don't know, Pom-poms. There's a reason I don't do girly stuff.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Which is exactly why you should try!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: That's... Not me at all. And it really sounds a little lame.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But I came to you for an idea, and that's what I got. Thanks, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No problem, Megan.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The boys already see you as one of them. If you change any part of yourself, they'll know it really isn't you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And you should play to your strengths. You know all of them, and that already gives you an advantage!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You just need to get them to notice you. If you challenge $Travis to arm wrestling, he'll definitely take note.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Wow, that actually makes a lot of sense... Thanks, Pom-poms.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No problem.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know what, despite the restaurant choice, I'm having a really good time.
That weekend, Sam and Colt spy on Taylor's date with Bryce at the local pizza restaurant...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Interesting restaurant choice, Bryce.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You don't like it?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, it's... Nice. I just don't like... Red-checkered tablecloths... And I don't eat pizza.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Probably should've told Bryce that Taylor is kind of high maintenance...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: It's a date.
At cheerleading practice later...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let me get this straight. You say you have a date for me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, and he's the perfect guy to take you to the Valentine's Day Ball. He's in college.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: College? Sam, I'm impressed. Fine, I'll give your guy a chance.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I'd better like him because if you've messed this up, you'll be on the bottom of the pyramid forever!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Gulp...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is that going to be a problem?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: No, it's just good to know.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Thanks for letting me know what to expect.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Are you sure? So she won't care what restaurant I'm taking her to or anything like that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nope. She eats everything.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Thanks, Sam. I was going to take her to that fancy Italian restaurant because girls usually like the nice places...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: But if she's okay eating anything...  I'll just take her to my favorite pizza place in town.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You just described Paula, except blonde.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, that really is the only difference between them.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: So... You lied.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, Bryce, what Sam means to say is that Taylor `is` much nicer than Paula, even if she is all those other things.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, Bryce, what Sam means to say is that Taylor [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] much nicer than Paula, even if she is all those other things.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If you give Taylor a chance, a date with her would be really fun.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Well... I guess I'll give this date thing a shot. Since Howard is vouching for her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She leads our cheerleading team like a pro!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's why we do so well performing at all the football games and inspiring our athletes.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Sounds like she's really good at what she does. That's cool.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: She's `bossy?` That doesn't sound attractive.
nodes.text_bbcode: She's [color=#e23b3b][i]bossy?[/i][/color] That doesn't sound attractive.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did I say 'bossy'? I must've meant 'bullying.'

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: That's even worse!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really, she's not that bad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's also, uh... Really bossy?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: That doesn't sound attractive.

nodes.text: Did I say 'bossy'? I must've meant 'bullying.'

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: That's even worse!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really, she's not that bad.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: So she `is` full of herself.
nodes.text_bbcode: So she [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] full of herself.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not what I meant! She just... Likes to talk about herself and thinks about herself all the time...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: That's what 'conceited' means.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But Taylor's totally...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I like a girl with confidence.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She certainly has a healthy ego.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And Taylor's totally...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uhm... Taylor's also, uh... `Conceited!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uhm... Taylor's also, uh... [color=#3b78e2][i]Conceited![/i][/color]

nodes.text: So she `is` full of herself.
nodes.text_bbcode: So she [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] full of herself.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not what I meant! She just... Likes to talk about herself and thinks about herself all the time...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: That's what 'conceited' means.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And Taylor's totally...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: It's always nice to see a girl trying to improve her personality.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The only thing I've seen her try to improve is her tan.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And there's nothing wrong with that. She also likes working out and just recently, she volunteered us to do some charity work for children.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And Taylor's also...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: She doesn't sound like fun to be around at all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I meant to say she's really nice... Like, all the time...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Or maybe just when she wants things from you...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You do `want` me to go on a date with her, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: You do [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] me to go on a date with her, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah! What I really mean is that Taylor's...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uhm... Uh... She's extremely self-centered!

nodes.text: She doesn't sound like fun to be around at all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I meant to say she's really nice... Like, all the time...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah! What I really mean is that Taylor's...
At the pool hall that evening, Sam, Colt, Howard, and $ZOE approach Bryce.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Bryce, thanks for meeting us here.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Anything for a former teammate. It's good to see you, man.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: But what are `you` doing here, Colt? Last time I saw you, you stole my wallet and tried to fight me!
nodes.text_bbcode: But what are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] doing here, Colt? Last time I saw you, you stole my wallet and tried to fight me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just along for the ride, Bryce. Unless you're in the mood to lose more money...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, Colt's with me. I wanted to ask you for a favor for my girlfriend's cousin. Sam, you want to tell him about your problem?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm looking for a date for the head cheerleader at Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Someone I know?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You might. When you were in high school, she was a sophomore. Her name is Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Taylor? I don't remember her...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's blonde, popular, hot...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Oh! Was she the one that was always shadowing Paula around and following her every order?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: No offense, but I'm not interested in dating someone like Paula...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Sure, she was hot. But she was a snob and really full of herself.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor is also snobby and full of herself, but I can't say those things if I want Bryce to date her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's see... Taylor is...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Bryce!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It might take some convincing, but I'm sure he'd be willing to do it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll tell him to meet us at the pool hall.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard! Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Spud!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really? You think Taylor would go for that type?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't he a little nerdy for her?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe she can look past his nerdy exterior..

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To see his nerdy interior?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's just see what happens.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Hawk!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really? That guy?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hate that guy. And so should you, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I'm not the one that's going to be dating him. Taylor thinks he's hot, and that's all that matters...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Adam!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't get me wrong. I like Adam, but he might not the best fit for Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But he was the toughest football player around! How would they not work?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I heard he's changed a little... But maybe Taylor will see that as being mature.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It'll be fine. It's just a date after all...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's been over a month! You've had more than enough time to find someone else!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not my fault you couldn't get a date, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Not your fault?!` So you just happened to end up dating Colt on accident?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Not your fault?![/i][/color] So you just happened to end up dating Colt on accident?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, well, I...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm cutting you off right there. Just for that, Sam, if you ever want to see the top of that pyramid again, you're going to do what I say.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And what I say is that the `team laundry needs to be done tonight, and you're doing it!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And what I say is that the [color=#3b78e2][i]team laundry needs to be done tonight, and you're doing it![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What do you have to say about that?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Anyway, I need a `date.` And I'm now accepting candidates for submission.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, I need a [color=#3b78e2][i]date.[/i][/color] And I'm now accepting candidates for submission.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We'll find you someone, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear! Happy hunting, girls!
All the cheerleaders, except Sam, leave.
Many hours later at Sam's house, Howard, $ZOE, and Colt sit around waiting for Sam to come home.
The door bursts open, and Sam comes in, wet and covered in bubbles and laundry suds.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, what happened? It took you four hours just to do the cheerleader uniforms?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She meant the uniforms for `every` team!
nodes.text_bbcode: She meant the uniforms for [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] team!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've had enough! This thing with Taylor has gone on long enough. I need to get her off my back.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just say the word, babe, and I can take care of Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Forget it, Colt. I'd rather just handle this on my own.

nodes.title: The Reluctant Matchmaker
nodes.subtitle: Can you help Sam make the perfect match?

nodes.text: After cheerleading practice one day...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hurry up and huddle up!
Sam, $ZOE, and the other cheerleaders join the huddle.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good work today, girls. One last thing before you leave...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As you know, the `Valentine's Day Ball` is coming up soon, and I want you all to remember that I'm angling for the `Queen of Hearts.`
nodes.text_bbcode: As you know, the [color=#3b78e2][i]Valentine's Day Ball[/i][/color] is coming up soon, and I want you all to remember that I'm angling for the [color=#3b78e2][i]Queen of Hearts.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's the Queen of Hearts?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's like the Homecoming Queen of Valentine's Day. Everyone votes on the most popular girl... In other words, it's Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't want to brag... But, yeah, it's totally going to be `me.` But there's one problem.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't want to brag... But, yeah, it's totally going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]me.[/i][/color] But there's one problem.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The Queen of Hearts never goes alone! And as previous candidates for my date were taken...
Taylor glares at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want to say anything, but it makes me so mad that Taylor's keeps harping on me and Colt dating!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That was the worst date I've ever been on! I would've rather been stood up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You should be demoted for even considering `that guy` as worthy to be my escort! This means bottom of the pyramid for life, Sam!
nodes.text_bbcode: You should be demoted for even considering [color=#3b78e2][i]that guy[/i][/color] as worthy to be my escort! This means bottom of the pyramid for life, Sam!

nodes.text: Oh no! Sam didn't fix anything!
Maybe if you'd chosen someone a little better for Taylor, things would've gone a little better for Sam!
Let's try that again!
Sam and Bryce step out of the store, arms loaded with an assortment of Valentine's day gifts.
They pack everything into the back of Howard's car...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Heart-shaped candy boxes, red balloons, and I can't believe they let us buy all those Valentine-themed lanterns for half-off!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is going to make Taylor so happy!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I sure hope so since I'm the one that's going to be setting everything up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I gave out advice, and I hope people leave me alone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure, Phil.
Later that night...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You really helped a lot of people today, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Wow, that's so decisive.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know, but from what you're telling me, it seems like you've already made up your mind, and you just want someone to tell you to go through with it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And when you're not excited about the relationship, it's hard to stay in one.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah.
Phil looks down.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Now that I've said it out loud, it feels like what I need to do. Thanks, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You and Kim have been together for so long that maybe it's worth it just to stay together.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Try to rekindle your feelings for each other. Find a new hobby to do together.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Like what? It seems like we don't have that much in common either.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: And she's so focused on the bakery and having her own business. I'm just not into that stuff.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You might be right though. I do still like Kim a lot, and we've been together for a year now.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I don't know if that's the best reason to stay together, but I shouldn't call it quits now.
Phil looks down sadly.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Thanks, Sam, for all your help.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're welcome.
Linda walks off.
Later after school...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey, Sam. Got a minute to talk?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure. It's not like I have other things to do than talk about other people's love lives.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But don't tell me you're having trouble getting a date for the Valentine's Ball. I know you have a girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah, about that...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I'm not sure how I feel about Kim anymore.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And you want to break up with her?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: That's the part I'm not sure about. It seems like Kim and I have just been more distant these last couple weeks.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: She got mad at me when I couldn't help her in the bakery, and then there's this entire Tom Prince thing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What does Tom Prince have to do with it?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I'm not sure, but I don't think she's that into a relationship with me anymore.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Have you talked to Kim about this?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I wanted to bring it up during Christmas, but she spent the entire time working in the bakery `with` Tom Prince.
nodes.text_bbcode: I wanted to bring it up during Christmas, but she spent the entire time working in the bakery [color=#e23b3b][i]with[/i][/color] Tom Prince.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want to tell you one thing or another, but it sounds like you should...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just `choose one.` Preferably, not Howard since he's `dating my cousin.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just [color=#3b78e2][i]choose one.[/i][/color] Preferably, not Howard since he's [color=#3b78e2][i]dating my cousin.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That doesn't work. That's what everyone else keeps telling me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe because it's what you should do!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Date Kenji or wait for Howard? Which one would you rather do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know, date Kenji?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're just saying that because your cousin's dating Howard!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, thanks, Sam. You weren't exactly helpful, but you said what I was planning on doing all along.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe the best choice is to not make a choice at all.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Figure yourself out. You're never going to be able to choose between Howard and Kenji if you don't know yourself first.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe it's time to stop worrying who you're dating and think about why you're dating.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow, Sam... That's really...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Great advice!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It is? What did I say again?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're right. I feel like everyone's telling me to just pick one of them, but the entire time, I don't even know what I want.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm going to take some time to think. Thanks, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Look, I know we're not exactly friends, but everyone's been saying that you give out great advice...
Sam and Bryce comb through the store, but come up with...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Leftover Halloween cinammon candy, orange and black balloons, and some spooky ghost lanterns...
They pack everything into the back of Howard's car...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: These are great... If you want to scare her into going with you.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Well, every girl likes chocolate, right?
At cheerleading practice the next day...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey, Sam, got a moment?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If this is about the team laundry again...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Not exactly. I wanted to tell you... Great cheering today!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Wow, thanks, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: You did so well, I thought I'd give you a choice today whether you wanted to do laundry or babysit Lyle tonight.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh. I guess I'll take Lyle...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But wait, you didn't like your date with Bryce?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Actually, I am pretty happy with him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I bet you already picked out what you're wearing to the Valentine's Day Ball...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's not in good taste to choose a dress before you get asked. And Bryce hasn't asked.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He hasn't?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I'm expecting it any day now. And I'm sure he has something special planned.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Something really romantic... Something amazing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, we'll make sure of that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What was that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nothing! Just thought of something I needed to do.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, wait, don't forget Lyle!
That night, Sam walks to the pool hall to see Bryce.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hey, Sam. What's up? You don't have another popular girl to set me up with, do you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll get straight to the point. Please say you have an elaborate scheme to ask Taylor out to the Valentine's Ball.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: The Valentine's Ball? What's that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, okay. The real reason for going out with Taylor was so you could ask her to this dance...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: A high school dance? Sounds kinda lame... But I don't have anything else to do, so sure, I'll ask her tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think she's expecting something a little bigger than you just asking her.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: How big?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're free for the rest of the evening, right?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: That big, huh?
After a short car ride to the party super store...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: So just asking her out after a moonlit stroll in a nice park isn't good enough?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A moonlit stroll in the park is `good,` but if you throw in a few things to create that romantic atmosphere...
nodes.text_bbcode: A moonlit stroll in the park is [color=#3b78e2][i]good,[/i][/color] but if you throw in a few things to create that romantic atmosphere...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It'll be great!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now come on, Bryce. Think Valentine's Day!
But it probably could've been a little better. Play again to get that perfect score!
Or else see you next time on Surviving High School!
Taylor runs up to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Taylor. How are things with Bryce?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Over!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?! Did he not ask you to the Ball?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I admit our first date was kind of nice...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But he doesn't appreciate the sacrifice necessary for true beauty at all if he took me to a pizza restaurant of all places.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I mean, does he `want` me to look like a cow?
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, does he [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] me to look like a cow?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But what about the way he asked you out to the Valentine's Day Ball?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That was just pathetic. I can't handle 'pathetic' in a guy I plan on dating.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The worst part is, since I ended up wasting so much time with him, I still don't have a date to the Valentine's Day Ball!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I know who I have to thank for tricking me into dating Bryce.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `YOU!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]YOU![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Say good-bye to the top of the pyramid, Sam. Because you're going to be permanently `bottom-heavy!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Say good-bye to the top of the pyramid, Sam. Because you're going to be permanently [color=#3b78e2][i]bottom-heavy![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Taylor storms angrily off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what about Kim and Phil?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, they stayed together! But... Maybe that wasn't for the best...
The night before, Phil walks into the bakery...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Kim, we've been through some rough patches.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yes, I know, Phil. And I was thinking...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: ...That we should stay together!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What? That's not what I was...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: ...Going to say?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Look, we're finishing each other's sentences. Deciding to stay with you wasn't such a bad idea after all...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And don't even get me started on `Linda.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And don't even get me started on [color=#3b78e2][i]Linda.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam sees Linda walk up to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard! I'm not going to give up until you're mine!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda, you're being so decisive. This is a side of you I've never seen before.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, it's a side you're going to get to see quite a lot of. Catch you later, Howard.
Linda struts away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! Since you told her to just pick one, she chose to go after mine!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE.
Suddenly Jessica walks up and pushes Sam!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sam! I heard that you told `Fryan` to go after me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam! I heard that you told [color=#3b78e2][i]Fryan[/i][/color] to go after me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, 'Fryan' really exists? I thought Ryan was making it up to get advice without letting me know it was him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you probably could've steered Fryan in a different direction... You know how much Jessica hates him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: 'Hate' is too weak a word, $ZOE. I `hate hate` him!
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Hate' is too weak a word, $ZOE. I [color=#3b78e2][i]hate hate[/i][/color] him!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There's no way I'd go out with `that!` He's just so `greasy!`
nodes.text_bbcode: There's no way I'd go out with [color=#3b78e2][i]that![/i][/color] He's just so [color=#3b78e2][i]greasy![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Fryan
nodes.text: Aww, Jessica. You say that now, but eventually, I will wear you down... Now, pucker up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ewww! Gross!
Jessica starts running.

nodes.speaker: Fryan
nodes.text: Sam did say that girls like to be chased... This is a good thing, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, that's not what I meant...
Fryan starts chasing Jessica across campus!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sam! I'm going to get you for this!!!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, things didn't turn out that well with Megan dressing like a girl...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe telling Megan to act like someone else wasn't the best idea.
In auto shop the day before...
Megan approaches the boys wearing a dress, make-up, and high heels!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey, guys.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Megan?! Is that `you?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Megan?! Is that [color=#e23b3b][i]you?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What? You've never seen a girl in a dress before?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I've just never seen you look so... Weird!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: What's next Megan? You gonna decorate your car with shiny stickers of My Cute Small Horse?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Grrr... Come here, $Travis, and I'll give you something that shines. And Kenji, I know where you live!
Megan lunges at the two boys, but trips over her shoes.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Kenji, run!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: At least she can't catch us in those heels!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: The first thing I'm going to stomp on when I get my boots back will be your sorry butts!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sam, the entire school's been talking about you... And people are not happy with your advice.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What now?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Are you trying to ruin my life? I wore the red dress, and he hated it! Black is always the appropriate date color.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's like you were deliberately sabotaging my date with the captain of the basketball team!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I did tell you, I knew nothing about fashion...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Thanks for nothing... Next time keep your advice to yourself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe being a matchmaker isn't your best career choice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I don't know if you could've given `worse` advice.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I don't know if you could've given [color=#3b78e2][i]worse[/i][/color] advice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hate to say it, Sam, but you've caused a lot of unhappiness.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What happened?
At school, Howard comes up to $ZOE and Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can always be the one to find her the perfect date for the Valentine's Day Ball.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's right! If I set her up with a great date, she won't be mad at me anymore!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But who can we set her up with? Most of the high school guys she can date are unpopular or lame.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why stop at high school? I know a few college guys.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Adam was on the football team back when I was a freshman. He's a little angsty, but he's single.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And there's Spud, of course, but he's nerdy. And he might be dating Kat. I never could tell...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, what about our skiing instructor? Hawk Gunner! Taylor was really into him. I bet she'd be happy to go out with him.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I `hate` that guy.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]hate[/i][/color] that guy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, don't forget Bryce! He was the alternate quarterback a few years ago. He's a nice guy.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah, Bryce. I hustled... Er, played pool with him once. He's got a library card, an expired membership to Cinemaworld, and a picture of his Mom in his wallet.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Good wallet, good guy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do you know all that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not my fault he left his wallet in plan grabbing-sight.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You have weird hobbies, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Anyway, those dates all sound great. Thanks, you guys!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So which one will you set Taylor up with?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's tough. I guess I'd set Taylor up with...
Howard and Sam drop Bryce off with the decorations.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good luck, Bryce! Let me know how it goes!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Thanks, Sam, for all your help. Bye!
At school, Sam feels a hand on her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Gaaaah!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, Sam? Can we talk?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know what anyone told you, but I didn't put anything in your shampoo!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's... Not what I wanted to talk to you about.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And I could really use some.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You too? Okay. What do you need help with exactly?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's just that I really want to try things again with Kenji, but I don't know for sure if it's right to date him if I still have feelings for Howard.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't want to hurt anyone! I... I just don't know what I want.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What do you suggest I do?

options.label: Take time to figure yourself out.

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: So Sam helped some people.. But not everyone's satisfied...
Maybe if you'd just made some better matches... Everyone would be a little happier.

nodes.text: The entire school's gone into utter pandemonium?!
Maybe if some better matches had been made, things would've gone a lot better for everyone!
Try again and see if you can help Sam make better choices!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Well, if I'm going on this date, there's one thing I want to know...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Is she a high maintenance girl or low maintenance one?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know, high maintenance. Needing a lot of attention and time, usually has expensive taste in everything.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Am I high maintenance?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, you're perfect.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You two... Blech.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: There's nothing harder to please than than a high-maintenance girl.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, Taylor is most definitely...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I have to say, when Sam told me she had a great guy for me to date, I never thought it'd be you, Bryce.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Disappointed?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not at all. So you know $USR? He gave my little brother a signed football for Christmas.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah, $USR's my roommate. He and I pledged for the same fraternity...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're in a fraternity?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: In the coolest brotherhood on campus, Mu Alpha Nu. You're looking at a MAN.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ooh, how `man`ly. Is it hard to get into?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh, how [color=#3b78e2][i]man[/i][/color]ly. Is it hard to get into?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah, you get hazed a bit, but it's all worth it in the end.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What did they make you do?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I'm not really allowed to tell, but because you're so cute...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hee hee.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Oh man, the things $USR and I had to do! This one time...
Later...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: And then we took every cupcake, cookie, and pie in sight!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow, that's sneaky! I bet that sorority didn't need them anyway.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hah.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Me too. We should do this again sometime.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Totally.
Taylor and Bryce leave the restaurant happily.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That seems to be going well! He seems like exactly her type!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, great. So can we go now? They're having a good time. Which is what we `should` be doing. Every minute here is a minute of us not making out!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, great. So can we go now? They're having a good time. Which is what we [color=#e23b3b][i]should[/i][/color] be doing. Every minute here is a minute of us not making out!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I'm really excited for Taylor and Bryce! Top of the pyramid, here I come!
That Monday at school, Sam and $ZOE walk down the hall.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And it looks like they're going on another date! I think Taylor's really happy with Bryce.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you stalk them through their entire date?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course! My position on the squad depended on whether or not the date was successful!
At that moment, Maria wanders up.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, Sam, I'm going out with this hot guy on Friday, and I can't decide if I want to wear a red or a black dress. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why are you asking me? Honestly, I don't know, Maria. Just pick the color you want.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I do like the red one better...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Wow, Sam, it's just like everyone says. You really are helpful!
Maria walks off happily.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is she talking about? Why is Maria asking `me` for `dating advice?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What is she talking about? Why is Maria asking [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] for [color=#3b78e2][i]dating advice?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know...
Suddenly, Megan approaches Sam.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey, Pom-poms. Got a moment?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll leave you two alone.
$ZOE walks off.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Look, this isn't going to happen often, but I need some advice, and I heard you were good at giving it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who told you that?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Word got around that you set Taylor up with a college guy, and everyone's say you're a natural matchmaker.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, that explains Maria. Look, Megan, I'm not a matchmaker. I just helped Taylor out, so she wouldn't keep channeling all her anger at me.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But I heard you did a good job with her. And you're going to do a good job with me, because I can channel a lot more painful anger than any cheerleader can!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Gulp! Okay... What do you need help with?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Valentine's Day Ball is coming up, and I kinda want to go with... With $Travis.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But he doesn't seem to notice me. You know, you'd think I'd have guys lining up around the block!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I mean, I can fix my own car, I love lug nuts and oil, and I'm not one of those weak, prissy girls who walk around in tight, trashy dresses all the time!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Plus, I'm around guys non-stop... And no one burps louder than me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe the problem is... $Travis see you as 'one of the guys.' It's not exactly a good place to be in for getting a date for a ball.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hmmm, that makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So if you want to go with $Travis, why don't you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Starting now, though, I am officially out of business!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You had a good run.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No more matchmaking or giving out love advice for me! Good night!
At the pool hall that evening, Sam, Colt, Howard, and $ZOE approach Bryce.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Bryce, thanks for meeting us here.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Anything for a former teammate. It's good to see you, man.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: But what are `you` doing here, Colt? Last time I saw you, you stole my wallet and tried to fight me!
nodes.text_bbcode: But what are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] doing here, Colt? Last time I saw you, you stole my wallet and tried to fight me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just along for the ride, Bryce. Unless you're in the mood to lose more money...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, Colt's with me. I wanted to ask you for a favor for my girlfriend's cousin. Sam, you want to tell him about your problem?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm looking for a date for the head cheerleader at Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Someone I know?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You might. When you were in high school, she was a sophomore. Her name is Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Taylor? I don't remember her...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's blonde, popular, hot...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Oh! Was she the one that was always shadowing Paula around and following her every order?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: No offense, but I'm not interested in dating someone like Paula...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Sure, she was hot. But she was a snob and really full of herself.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor is also snobby and full of herself, but I can't say those things if I want Bryce to date her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's see... Taylor is...
Thanks to Sam's matchmaking, it looks like things are looking up for many of the students at Centerscore!
You played a great game!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So which one will you set Taylor up with?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's tough. I guess I'd set Taylor up with...

nodes.text: Ahhhh! My face!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hawk Gunner?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I have to say when Sam told me she had a great guy for me to date, I never thought it'd be you.

nodes.text: Hey, Sammy, check it out. I carved something great into the ice.

nodes.text: Oh, Hawk, you're so cool!

nodes.text: I didn't know there was a 'Hawk' in...

nodes.text: Hey, Hawk... Want to come skate with us?

nodes.text: It's so cold out here, we could use the heat.

nodes.text: Unfortunately, I `do` object.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: But you could be one of the Hawk-ettes.

nodes.text: I hate sharing anything with `anyone.` And that especially includes `boys.` Sorry, Hawk Gunner. Get out of my face.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I have to say when Sam told me she had a great guy for me to date, I never thought it'd be you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I always thought you were pretty awesome.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Hey, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You helped our team win so many football games.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yeah, those were some good times. But I kind of grew out of that. Football is important, but it isn't everything, you know?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Except when it is...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But whatever. So why'd you bring me to this theater? Because it's dark enough to make out in?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Actually, I brought you here to enjoy the live beat poetry reading they're holding here tonight. There are some awesome artists in house, and...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Poetry?!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yeah, you know, art that rhymes.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But that's, like, English class. It's so... Uncool.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: No, it's not. It's an expressive, emotive art form.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So is punching people... Can't you threaten to slug somebody? Just once? For me?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Sorry, Taylor. My days of threatening people are over. Or at least until we face Wilson U in football again...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What about calling someone 'meat'? That's light threatening.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I'm a little different than I was in high school, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You used to be so cool. Now I just don't know who you are anymore.
Taylor stands up and leaves the theater, dejected.

nodes.text: Looks like Taylor just told Adam to 'beat' it...
